# 0z

> A desk of AI workspaces that runs entirely in the browser. Bring your own API key (Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, xAI, Mistral, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or a local engine); the key calls the provider directly and every note stays on the device. Vanilla JavaScript, no build step, no server. Code Apache 2.0, art reserved.

## Open a desk

- [The whole suite](https://sumbhodi.github.io/0z/app/): every card and every bot — a tutor, a nurse, a coder (editor, preview, shell), a newsroom, a time-travel clock, an arcade, a vault.
- [desk n dog](https://sumbhodi.github.io/0z/deskndog/): the desk, the dog (a chat companion), and the chart he wakes up reading.
- [hello nurse](https://sumbhodi.github.io/0z/nurse/): a clipboard that remembers — sleep, food and movement in plain words, never a diagnosis; prints a prep sheet for an appointment.
- [the tutor](https://sumbhodi.github.io/0z/tutor/): asks before it answers; files lecture transcripts by class, builds one-screen study sheets in the teacher's own words, practice and test bars.
- [the tithe](https://sumbhodi.github.io/0z/tithe/): the dog, the nurse and the tutor in one desk.

## How it works

- Each bot plans in the open: chat names the cards, a planner writes the steps, a runner fires the tools, a checker reads the surface back. The human sees every step and presses a green button for anything that leaves the device.
- Accessibility is the product: every control is named, large, keyboard-walkable; a "steadier targets" mode and "bigger everything" are one press away.
- Also live at https://0zhub.com/ (the same suite with a waiting-room splash and a free shelf of desktop downloads).
